title: 第25章 荒林枯井玄天战镜2第26章 安师姐他叫周元
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
“储物袋非常罕见，最普通的都能炒到上千颗灵石。谁会丢在这里？”
“储物袋跟主人是有联系的，丢了也能找到。”
“难道是故意遗弃的？”
周元想不明白，可现在归他了。
“里面有灵石吗？有储物袋的，身份肯定不一般，灵石……灵法……灵丹……”周元满心期待的检查，可是到最后只掏出来一个铁质圆盘。
只有半尺左右，非常小巧，拿在手里沉甸甸的，正反两面都雕刻着密密麻麻的神秘纹路。细看之下又是层层叠叠，如同镂空似得。
“就是这个。”识海里响起二爷的声音。
“这是什么东西？”周元惊讶，储物袋竟然都只是前菜。
“武器。”
“怎么用的？”
周元现在确实是缺一件武器，可他期待的是刀剑之类的，再不济给根棍子、给条枪。但是手里这个……周元看了又看，既不像个镜子也不像个盘子，难道当板砖用吗？
“注入灵气试试就知道了。”二爷也好奇，这次福缘给的感知，比起地髓石和灵源宝树还要强烈，应该不是个简单玩意儿。
“宝器吗？”
灵宝图鉴有介绍，灵修所用的武器共分三类。
宝器、灵器、圣器。
三品之下，是为宝器。多由玄铁、宝钢等稀有材质铸造，或坚不可摧，或锋锐难当，或增幅灵法，或辅助战斗。
使用方法简单，注入灵气便可。
周元捧起铁盘，释放出了雷灵之气，好奇又期待的等待着。会是什么样的灵器，能发挥出什么样的威力？
可是……
等了又等，雷灵之气不断冲击，却始终没有任何反应。

“灵器？”
周元和二爷异口同声。
宝器有强有弱，可终究是死物，威能上限全看材质与铸术。而三品之上的武器，可称灵器。
这种武器不只是锻造材质特殊，还需要辅助天地奇珍，更要经历天火真炎千锤百炼。
真正神异之处在于其内蕴灵韵，能释放玄妙神通，甚至能与主人心意相通，自行护主杀敌。
周元看着手里的圆盘，呼吸都急促了起来。
灵修们通常用的都是宝器，灵器非常的罕见，而且价值连城，可遇不可求。
即便是最普通的四品灵器，也是难得的灵宝。
像那些玄灵境、地灵境的灵修都未必能拥有。
使用灵器，需精血认主。
“真是灵器吗？”
周元逼出精血，带着期待和紧张，滴落到了圆盘上。
content_en:
"Storage bags are very rare. The most common ones can be bought for thousands of spirit stones. Who would leave them here?"
"The storage bag is connected to its owner, and it can be found even if it is lost."
"Could it be abandoned on purpose?"
Zhou Yuan couldn't understand, but now it belongs to him.
"Are there any spirit stones in there? Anyone with a storage bag must have an unusual identity. Spirit stones...spiritual methods...spiritual pills..." Zhou Yuan checked with great expectation, but in the end he only took out an iron disc.
Only about half a foot, it is very small and heavy in the hand. Both the front and back are engraved with dense mysterious lines. Upon closer inspection, there are layers of layers, which look like hollows.
"That's it." Second Master's voice sounded in the sea of ​​consciousness.
"What is this?" Zhou Yuan was surprised that the storage bags were just appetizers.
"Weapons."
"How to use it?"
Zhou Yuan is indeed short of a weapon now, but what he is looking forward to is a sword or something like that. If not, he can give him a stick or a gun. But this thing in his hand... Zhou Yuan looked at it again and again. It didn't look like a mirror or a plate. Could it be used as a brick?
"Just try injecting spiritual energy and you will know." The second master was also curious. The perception given by Fuyuan this time was stronger than the Earth Marrow Stone and the Spiritual Source Treasure Tree. It should not be a simple thing.
"A treasure?"
The Lingbao Illustrated Book introduces that the weapons used in spiritual practice are divided into three categories.
A treasure, a spiritual weapon, a sacred weapon.
Below the third level, it is a treasure. Most of them are made of rare materials such as black iron and precious steel. They are either indestructible or sharp, amplify spiritual skills, or assist in combat.
The method of use is simple, just inject spiritual energy.
Zhou Yuan held up the iron plate, released the thunder spirit energy, and waited curiously and expectantly. What kind of spiritual weapon will it be, and what kind of power can it exert?
But...
After waiting and waiting, the thunder spirit energy continued to attack, but there was still no response.
"Spiritual weapon?"
Zhou Yuan and Er Ye said in unison.
Treasure weapons may be strong or weak, but they are dead objects after all. The upper limit of their power depends on the material and casting technique. Weapons above the third level can be called spiritual weapons.
This kind of weapon is not only forged with special materials, but also requires the assistance of rare treasures from heaven and earth, and it also needs to be tempered by the true flames of sky fire.
What is truly magical is that it contains aura, can release mysterious magical powers, and can even connect with its owner's mind and protect it and kill enemies on its own.
Zhou Yuan looked at the disk in his hand and his breathing became rapid.
Spiritual practitioners usually use treasures. Spiritual weapons are very rare and extremely valuable. They are hard to come by.
Even the most common fourth-grade spiritual weapon is a rare spiritual treasure.
Spiritual cultivation such as those in the Mysterious Spiritual Realm and the Earthly Spiritual Realm may not be possible.
To use a spiritual weapon, you need essence and blood to identify its owner.
"Is it really a spiritual weapon?"
Zhou Yuan forced out the essence and blood, dripping onto the disk with anticipation and nervousness.
